content.rendered:
Timelapse video of construction of GreenWorks Recycling Plant in Peabody, MA. The 50,000 square foot MRF started up on January 12, 2015. The plant processes dual and single stream recycling and includes a Bollegraaf HBC 140 baler, dual paper screens, a fines screen, and two TITECH autosort models from VAN DYK Recycling Solutions (https://vdrs.com). The design layout leaves room to accommodate future expansions and upgrades.
